name: GL_USSGL_TRANSACTION_CODES
description: GL_USSGL_TRANSACTION_CODES contains user defined codes that tell Oracle General Ledger how to generate budgetary transactions from proprietary transactions. This allows Oracle General Ledger to support the requirements of the United States Standard General Ledger.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
